Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + next steps (Redwood Inference)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday to walk through StellarApps' ingestion and personalization use cases. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

- Needs: lower-latency generation for personalized content and an embeddings pipeline for search/relevance.
- Constraints: multi-tenant data isolation for PII, SOC2 evidence required, tightening budget window for Q3.
- Proposed pilot: 3-week evaluation on a subset of traffic (dedicated capacity) + Redwood monitoring dashboard.

Next steps I suggested:
1) I’ll share discovery notes + a proposed mutual action plan by EOD.
2) Can you confirm the procurement owner (I think procurement@stellarapps.com) and whether there are any mandatory MSA clauses to flag early?
3) Are there any hard dates for budget/approval we should be aware of?

Attaching the discovery notes and our baseline pricing sheet for reference. Happy to hop on a quick 15-min follow-up next week to lock timelines.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao

aditya@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Hi Elena —

Heading into quarter-end and wanted to check in quickly: has StellarApps' priority or timeline for this project shifted? Two specific questions so your team can flag if anything changed: 

1) Budget/approval: is the approval still expected in Q3, or has this been pushed to next quarter?
2) Priority: given competing initiatives, should we pause active outreach or keep the pilot planning moving?

If helpful, I can put together a short mutual action plan with dates and owners to make approvals easier for procurement. If your team needs more info from Security/Compliance, Marissa (copied) can share our SOC2 pack and data retention notes.

If you’re free for a 10–15 min check on Friday, I’ll book time; otherwise, a quick reply here works fine. 

Thanks and talk soon,
Aditya Rao

Elena —

Last note this quarter — wanted to surface a couple of pragmatic options depending on where things landed on your side: 

A) If approvals/budget are still on track: we can do a short pilot in July. I’ll send a mutual action plan + a draft MSA redline for Procurement to speed review.
B) If the project is deprioritized for Q3: happy to pause outreach and schedule a check-in for early Q4 — we’ll also keep trial credits open if you want to run a small PoC later.

Also attaching an updated pricing sheet and a neutral MSA stub (StellarApps_MSA_v2.pdf) to make it easy for your procurement and legal teams to start review.

Would you prefer A or B? A quick reply is perfect.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: pricing-sheet-20260630.pdf, StellarApps_MSA_v2.pdf

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@stellarapps.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery recap + EOQ priority check - final end-of-quarter touch

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the follow-ups and for putting everything together. We’re wrapping up a few internal budget conversations this week; I don’t have a firm yes yet. Headcount and a higher-priority analytics rewrite have put pressure on new vendor commitments for Q3. 

Can you do B for now — pause active outreach and keep the offer open? If approvals come through early next month I’ll re-open. Please leave the MSA and pricing docs in the thread; I’ll share with procurement when appropriate.

Appreciate the patience.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform | StellarApps
